process_name: Recombinant Industrial Lipase - E. coli Fermentation Process
development_scale: 10 L seed fermenter / 150 L production fermenter

unit_operations.name: Seed Fermentation
unit_operations.description: Shake flask to 10 L seed fermenter expansion, 16-18 hr, OD600 target reached before transfer.

unit_operations.name: Production Fermentation (Fed-Batch, IPTG Induction)
unit_operations.description: 150 L fed-batch fermentation with glycerol feed; IPTG induction at mid-log phase for recombinant expression.

unit_operations.name: Cell Harvest (Centrifugation)
unit_operations.description: Continuous centrifugation to pellet cells; resuspend in lysis buffer.

unit_operations.name: High-Pressure Homogenization (Lysis)
unit_operations.description: Two passes through high-pressure homogenizer to lyse cells and release soluble enzyme.

unit_operations.name: Clarification (Depth Filtration)
unit_operations.description: Depth filtration to remove cell debris from lysate.

unit_operations.name: Anion Exchange Capture
unit_operations.description: IEX bind-elute capture step exploiting target enzyme's acidic pI.

unit_operations.name: Hydrophobic Interaction Chromatography Polish
unit_operations.description: HIC step to remove host cell protein and aggregated species.

unit_operations.name: UF/DF Formulation
unit_operations.description: Ultrafiltration/diafiltration into final storage buffer with stabilizing excipients.

unit_operations.name: Sterile Filtration & Fill
unit_operations.description: 0.2 um sterile filtration into final bulk containers.
